name: Bulgu
body:
BULGU
CR 9

This axe-faced monstrosity has four eyes that gleam with cunning, and powerful, stump-like arms.

XP 6,400
NE Huge aberration
Init +1; Senses darkvision 120 ft.; Perception +26

DEFENSE

AC 23, touch 9, flat-footed 22 (+1 Dex, +14 natural, –2 size)
hp 115 (14d8+52)
Fort +8, Ref +7, Will +12
Immune fear; SR 20

OFFENSE

Speed 30 ft.
Melee 2 slams +17 (1d6+9), bite +17 (2d6+9/19-20)
Space 15 ft.; Reach 15 ft.
Spell-Like Abilities (CL 14th; concentration +15)

At Will—mage hand, message
3/day—telekinesis (DC 16)
1/day—alarm, arcane eye, arcane lock, clairvoyance, glyph of warding (DC 14), knock, locate creature (DC 15), locate object, nondetection, see invisibility

STATISTICS

Str 29, Dex 12, Con 19, Int 15, Wis 20, Cha 13
Base Atk +10; CMB +21; CMD 32
Feats Awesome Blow, Improved Bull Rush, Improved Critical (bite), Improved Natural Attack, Lightning Reflexes, Power Attack
Skills Acrobatics +11, Intimidate +18, Knowledge (arcana) +19, Knowledge (religion) +9, Perception +26, Stealth +10; Racial Modifiers +4 Perception
Languages Abyssal, Aklo, Common

SPECIAL ABILITIES

Keen Hearing (Ex)

A bulgu has a +2 circumstance bonus on Perception checks based on hearing. As a swift action, it can release subsonic sounds and read the echoes, gaining blindsense until the end of its turn or until it moves, if sooner.

ECOLOGY

Environment any temperate or warm
Organization solitary
Treasure standard

A bulgu is an enormous figure, with four glowing eyes, an axe-shaped face, and stumpy, log-like arms and legs. It eats humanoid creatures. Despite its brute appearance and habits, it possesses intelligence and eldritch cunning. Although it is possible to communicate with it, it would take great power to hold it at bay long enough to have a conversation, and what it had to say could be more unsettling and dangerous than useful. It has a number of magic powers. Elders of its kind might be even more powerful.

A bulgu is terrifying and loathsome, burying its wedge-shaped, toothed skull into opponents, while battering them with its arms. It leaves only scraps behind from its victims, along with considerable gore.

A bulgu has means, both magical and mundane, of acquiring the secrets of its targets. Not satisfied with slaughter, it sometimes engages in blackmail, harassment, and unspeakable torture. Once it chooses a victim, even the victim’s whole family or village could be in danger.
